# input-core keep fixtures

Real single-core complexes used to develop and test the `input` coordination shape
(docs/plans/confgen-input-core-upgrade.md). Coordinates are the experimental structures with the
metal moved to atom 0 and the metal at the origin; `index.json` lists 0-based donors, charge and
multiplicity. cd6_bpy3, ti7_salan and zr8_onn made the input-core DG bounds unsmoothable before
the bounds were widened to admit the input; cd7_ntb holds a kappa2-nitrate whose N lies 2.84 A
from Cd without being a donor.
